reason: The source diff changes local-search move evaluation: it can skip time-window segment work when a move is already non-improving, caches vehicle-type data on routes, and revises SwapStar insertion evaluation. These are active solver-engine mechanisms with possible effects on both per-move cost and accepted search moves.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Avoiding unnecessary time-window calculations and repeated vehicle-type lookup may reduce local-search work per candidate. Any changed move costs can also redirect the incumbent trajectory, so end-to-end route quality and time-to-target must be measured.
causal_chain: Exchange and reversed moves return early once the non-time-window delta cannot improve; Route keeps vehicle properties locally; SwapStar recomputes insertion costs with revised route indices. These choices alter candidate-evaluation cost and may alter which moves survive pruning.
structural_trigger: Routing instances with active local search, time windows or nonzero fixed vehicle costs, and SwapStar/Exchange candidate moves; capacity-only routes lacking these features are controls.
activation_probe: Count each changed operator's candidate calls, early exits before time-window merging, route fixed-cost reads, SwapStar insertion evaluations, accepted moves, and original-instance validity on paired builds.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze visible routing families by time-window tightness, fleet costs, and size before hidden scoring; retain capacity-only nontrigger controls, all seeds, and every timeout or invalid solution.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared PyVRP source driver and independent CVRP-family verifier, but first prove which time-window and vehicle-cost branches run on the chosen public panel. A plain CVRP panel cannot qualify a branch it never activates.
mathematical_risk: An incorrect early exit or cached vehicle cost can miss a valid improving move or accept a move with the wrong cost; route feasibility, objective accounting, and time-window constraints require independent original-instance checks.
independent_check_plan: Verify every returned route against original capacity, time-window, and vehicle constraints, recompute distance, penalties, and fixed costs, and compare targeted operator deltas with a reference evaluator on small cases.
hidden_generalization_plan: Measure verified incumbent quality, time-to-target, and regressions on held-out routing sizes and time-window/fleet structures with paired fixed budgets and seeds.
overlap_review: Compare neighboring PyVRP route and operator PRs for shared C++ edits. This PR's combined local-search patch counts once; a different task needs a separate pre-PR state or independently distinct Agent goal and workload.
resource_risk: Caching vehicle-type objects increases per-route memory, while additional branch checks or changed insertion loops can slow easy routes despite fewer time-window merges.
